_doc: Profiles for scripts/havok/gr2_lint.py. 'references' = numbers MEASURED on vanilla models (python scripts/havok/gr2_lint.py --measure-reference <vanilla.gr2>, files extracted to a scratchpad, never into the repo); never on a pilot or on the model under test.
'profiles' = one building each: its files, the reference it must match, and its own design facts (platform height, props on the fixed base bone) with the reason for each tolerance.

Frames: 'raw' = the gr2 file's own coordinates (y up). 'display' = (-x_raw, -z_raw, y_raw): +X right, +Y back, +Z up, as rotate_gr2.py documents. Quadrants are display-frame, relative to the footprint (bbox) centre.

tools._doc: gr2_to_raw.py (headless Granny DLL read under Wine/WSL). $VARIABLES = this device's local environment (scripts/tools/local_env.py: the environment, else config/aop.local.env); override: env GR2_LINT_TOOLS. Missing -> the dll_read check is SKIP, never PASS.
tools._owner_messages_doc: the owner's message store: a waiver in a profile's "waivers" counts only when its owner_quote is one of his WHOLE messages there (as the UV lineage gate). AOP_TASKS_DIR not set on this device or the file missing -> no waiver counts.

texture_budget._doc: AoP texture CEILINGS (this project only; owner 2026-09-30 m334, classes m335/m336; KTC-165). gr2_lint check texture_budget counts a model's own texture SETS (one per BaseColor; the sizes from the DDT headers) against its class. The class is set PER MODEL with the owner: a profile's texture_budget {class, confirmed_by: owner message id, models: [the model stems it covers]}; per_model entries (keyed by the model stem) override it. A class without confirmed_by is PROPOSED and FAILS the export: 'class not confirmed by the owner'. INC-033: confirmed_by must resolve to his message in the store (tools.owner_messages) that names the class and the model (the entry's or profile's "names"); a confirmed folder class covers only its "models" (the market folder also holds a house and a port); every own texture file of every stage and variant counts, and the animfile's replacetexture targets. The universal UV density floor is not here: .claude/skills/blender-architecture-texturing/references/uv-density-floor.md.

unit_human_1024._doc: PROPOSED: one 1024 set (BaseColor, Normals, Masks, Details) for a human unit's body and any weapon skinned into it; an attachment model (a helmet, a bow) is a separate gr2 with its own .material, linted on its own

unit_references._doc: Numbers MEASURED on vanilla units (python scripts/havok/gr2_lint.py --measure-unit-reference <vanilla.gr2> --material <its .material> --pose-npz <seated idle pose>; files read from a scratch extraction, never the repo), 2026-10-11. density = blender-organic-uv's evaluator definitions (uvlib.face_metrics, wquantile); visibility = gr2_lint.face_visibility, a numpy port of uv_eval_blender.face_visibility that reproduces the evaluator's iron_rider_0 run (VAN_iron_rider_0_body) exactly: visible-weighted p10/p50/p90 313.4/342.2/400.3, never-visible area 0.3182. Pose NPZ from aoe3de-unit-animation pose_sim (rider clip on the posed vanilla horse, rider origin = bone_attachpoint), camera pitch 47, 8 headings, single-sided.

unit_rider_1024.status: profile confirmed by the owner 2026-10-11; texture class per model pending (INC-033)
unit_rider_1024._doc: OWNER 2026-10-11: confirmed this rider profile in principle - his answer 'Yes, confirm it (Recommended)' to 'Confirm the proposed rider check profile unit_rider_1024 (the gate every unit must pass before a game test)?' (one 1024 texture per human unit, limits measured on vanilla riders, the universal UV density floor on top). The unit texture class still FAILS per model until confirmed_by points at his own message in the owner store naming the class and the model (INC-033), recorded when the first unit model exists. The export lint of a new skinned RIDER whose body (and any weapon skinned into it) shares one 1024 page. Generic checks: crc, fixups, dll_read, vertex_limit, wrap16, tangents, winding, materials. Unit checks: unit_skeleton (one reference skeleton byte for byte: names, order, parents, rest matrices), unit_weights (8-bit sums 255, descending, no bone twice, cap 4, unused slots repeat slot 0, weighted bones inside the measured set), unit_vertex (the vanilla 40-byte skinned layout and DE fill), unit_budget (triangles and welded vertices within the measured vanilla rider maxima), texture_budget (unit class unit_human_1024, PROPOSED: FAILS until the owner confirms), unit_density (the organic UV gate profile's density minima instead of the building density floor; the visible-weighted part needs --pose-npz). The vanilla references iron_rider_0 and keshik_rider_rank01 pass it (scripts/havok/tests/test_gr2_lint_unit.py). Not covered yet: LowPoly (_lp) models, rigid attachment models, infantry.

unit._budget_doc: the maxima over the 20 referenced DE full-LOD riders (steppe_rider_2: 1504 triangles, 1061 welded vertices; aoe3de-unit-model vanilla-unit-measurements.md, measure_units.py); references: iron_rider_0 1328 / 976, keshik_rider_rank01 1278 / 981

The visible-weighted density needs the unit's seated idle pose (--pose-npz: its Idle variant 0 rider clip key 0 on its horse's Idle variant 0 clip key 0).
